idea-plugin.name: Any Player
idea-plugin.description:
A video player, audio player and image viewer for your IDE.

Open media from your project, a local path or a direct HTTP(S) URL.

  • Video and audio playback with seeking, speed, volume, audio tracks and subtitles.
  • Images and seekable GIF, animated WebP and APNG with frame stepping.
  • Live and full-file spectrograms of the selected source audio track.
  • Interactive waveform with zoom, scrolling and separate audio channels.
  • MediaInfo properties and complete reports.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: video/audio playback, images and seekable animations, live/full-file spectrograms, interactive waveforms and MediaInfo. Supports local paths and direct HTTP(S) media URLs. Buffered live analysis keeps plot edges stable while scrolling. Native packages are available for Windows, macOS and Linux on x86_64 and ARM64.

action.description: Open a media URL or local path in AnyPlayer
